summary: Twenty-seven documents have landed since the run's watermark: one tier-5 YipitData cloud-spend panel (unaddressed since 2026-07-23, still unactioned) and 26 tier-10 screener wire events. The YipitData panel still clears the materiality gate (68) and, newly, two independent-origin wire reports (Fortune, Nasdaq) corroborate a 2026 AI-capex guidance raise from $200B to $220B disclosed on Amazon's Q2 2026 earnings call -- a call not yet reflected as a primary filing/transcript in the pool. Together these justify the same three-orb scoped rerun as the prior plan (earnings/guidance-consensus, earnings/revenue-drivers, business-model/moat) plus their module-synthesis cascade. The single highest-priority unconfirmed item is a headline-only Yahoo Finance claim that Amazon's debt nearly doubled to $129B in six months (materiality 75 if true) -- no filing or second independent source corroborates it, so it stays note_only pending the actual Q2 2026 10-Q or a second source. All other new documents (a $25B bond-sale report, ESG/regulatory colour on AI data-center buildout, a New Jersey antitrust suit, a Florida facility closure, and a syndicated Prime Video Latin America investment) are single-sourced and/or below the materiality gate.
